comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body:
I also caught this just outside British Isles North landing area.

Takes some time to get though. I had R17 Fishing and I spent 30 minutes sitting outside landing area when I finally got it.

comments.author: Yihwa
comments.body: This is anecdotal but I had a hard time catching it at the coordinates above (spent about an hour just sitting there). When I hugged the coast on the bay (around where Inverness is), I caught it fairly quickly on two characters.
